title: GateCredentialStatus
description: Response of GET /passkey/status on the phone listener, which needs no session. enrolled is true when the gate holds at least one unrevoked passkey; when it is false the PWA blocks Approve and links to /enroll. revoked is true when the gate holds no unrevoked passkey but did enrol one that was revoked, so the PWA can tell a revoked passkey from one never enrolled (enrolled and revoked are never both true). sessionExpiresAt is when the session cookie sent with the request ends, or null when there is no valid session. recovery is present only while a passkey recovery is pending (started with the recovery key, not cancelled, not yet expired); it carries the window and nothing else.
